description: Hushbreak - VLC add-on that hushes the ad breaks on Triton/StreamTheWorld radio streams such as KINK.
post_install: # VLC only loads scripts from its own Lua folders; copy them there (per user, no admin rights).
Write-Host "Hushbreak scripts copied into $vlcLua - restart VLC if it is running."
post_uninstall: Write-Host "Hushbreak scripts removed from $vlcLua. VLC's own preferences (Extra interface modules / Lua interface) are left as they are."
notes: Tell VLC to run Hushbreak, once, in Tools > Preferences (Show settings: All):
Interface > Main interfaces > Extra interface modules: luaintf
Interface > Main interfaces > Lua > Lua interface: hushbreak
or start VLC with: vlc --extraintf luaintf --lua-intf hushbreak <stream.pls>
Settings (optional) go in Lua > Lua interface configuration, e.g. hushbreak={duck_percent=60,min_volume=10}
Watch it work in Tools > Messages (verbosity 2, filter 'hushbreak').
